meta.author: Claude (A,B) + Chen via browser (C,D) + GPT 5.4 Pro via PM prompt, relocated by Claude (E,F)
meta.purpose: 6 candidate BLUE_LAUNCHER_POSITIONS layouts for long-running RL iteration baseline. Each layout is land-valid (every position passes terrain.point_on_south_land). Apply to config.py AFTER Fix worker lands to avoid merge conflict.

coverage_methodology.site_ring_defenders: # of launchers whose max_range ring contains the site position. Under-counts PAC-3 effectiveness against HGV since PAC-3 intercepts along HGV flight-path, not at the site.
coverage_methodology.htk_count_per_site: # of PAC-3 whose ring contains the site — last-ditch HTK backstop.
coverage_methodology.hgv_path_km: Sum of PAC-3 flight-path intercept windows (PAC-3 perpendicular distance from southbound HGV line < 60km). Higher = more chances to engage HGV in-flight before it reaches site.

layouts.author: Claude
layouts.name: Forward HGV Hunter
layouts.philosophy: Two PAC-3 (forward on peninsula + rear at base) for early-engagement HGV coverage of every site.

layouts.author: Claude
layouts.name: East Reinforced
layouts.philosophy: Cheaper defense-in-depth. Fix Firewatch weakness with CIWS + east SLS. Accept no PAC-3 HTK at Spear (same as default).

layouts.author: Chen (browser drag)
layouts.name: Heavy Saturation + Forward Catchers
layouts.philosophy: 23 launchers. 8 CIWS (3 forward-offset from Main Base for approach-corridor intercept per Chen's intent, not co-located). 2 PAC-3 split (peninsula Spear + east mid). 8 launchers covering 0 sites are intentional threat-corridor catchers.
layouts.notes: Chen confirmed CIWS offsets are intentional for approach-corridor intercept. Budget-tight ($35M for interceptors) — long match may exhaust funds.

layouts.author: Chen (browser drag)
layouts.name: Forward-Island HGV Hunter + RBS Saturation Belt
layouts.philosophy: PAC-3 on far-north islands (east at (127,119), west at (39,64)) — each gives ~100+ km of HGV flight-path intercept window for at least one site. 6 RBS-70 along south coast Y=5-20 form east-west saturation belt for cruise/drone. Clean 1-CIWS-per-site for terminal defense.
layouts.notes: 0 PAC-3 in site-ring for Main Base and Firewatch — if both forward PAC-3 miss HGV in-flight, those 2 sites have no HTK backstop. Trusts forward intercept geometry to do the work.

layouts.author: GPT 5.4 Pro (via PM prompt), relocated to land by Claude
layouts.name: Balanced Layered Shield
layouts.philosophy: Layered defense: CIWS at each of 3 sites + mid/long-range SLM/SLS/RBS-70 forward + 1 PAC-2 forward-center + 2 PAC-3 (forward peninsula + rear). Mixed-threat balanced coverage.
layouts.notes: GPT's original 8/12 positions were in sea (no terrain knowledge). Relocation preserves design intent where land allows. Mid-band (Y=20-65) is mostly sea so GPT's mid-layer concept compresses toward coast or peninsula tips.

layouts.author: GPT 5.4 Pro (via PM prompt), relocated to land by Claude
layouts.name: Anti-HGV PAC-3 Fence
layouts.philosophy: Pure 4-PAC-3 fence across forward islands + peninsula + south coast. All $60M in HIT-TO-KILL platforms. Max HGV flight-path coverage, zero dedicated anti-drone/cruise. Extremist design — stress-tests the hypothesis that HGV kills > mixed-threat absorption.
relocation_log: pac_3 (62,90)→(39,55) — west fence (sea→west small island, -35km closer to arena centerline but only west land option)
pac_3 (95,28)→(85,18) — rear backup (sea→south mainland north coast)
layouts.notes: HGV path coverage numbers are spectacular (263km for Firewatch, 353km for Main Base). But: 0 CIWS/RBS/SLS/SLM means any drone that gets past PN guidance = free damage. RL will rapidly learn to exploit drone-spam against this layout. Useful as baseline extreme for RL curriculum bootstrap.

philosophy_comparison.description: Balanced — fwd+rear PAC-3, full defender coverage
Cheap — single PAC-3, Firewatch beefed up, most interceptor budget
Forward HGV hunt from islands + RBS belt
GPT's layered shield — balanced but thin defender count
GPT's HTK extremist — max HGV path, zero anti-drone

key_constraints.land_validity: Every (x, y) must pass terrain.point_on_south_land. South mainland is Y=0-18 km strip; peninsula around (78-85, 65-85); forward-east island around (125-130, 88-110); small west island (35-40, 40-60). Mid-band Y=20-65 is mostly sea except small_island.
key_constraints.single_pac_3_coverage_limit: From any single point on south land, a PAC-3 (60 km range) can cover at most 2 of 3 sites. Covering all 3 requires 2+ PAC-3s.
key_constraints.pac_2_sweet_spot: (74.7, 8) km is the only single point where PAC-2 (70 km) reaches all 3 sites (Spear at 69.0/70 km — 1 km margin).
key_constraints.ciws_placement: CIWS offset from a site (4-8 km away) is intentional approach-corridor intercept, not a coverage miss. Chen confirmed this is his design choice in slot C.
